title: A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift
start: Talk to the Fairy Queen at Fairy Resistance Hideout, reached by using the main fairy ring in Zanaris.
prereq_quests: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen

items.t: Nuff's certificate (if dropped, another can be found in Fairy Nuff's grotto)
Bucket of milk (in Zanaris a bucket spawns just west of the mill and there is a dairy cow just east of the wheat field)
Secateurs (can be obtained during the quest; Magic secateurs will not work; tool belt will not work)
Hammer (can be obtained during the quest; tool belt will not work)

recommended.t: Potions that improve your combat abilities
Good weapon and armour (Dragon equipment or better)
8 Willow logs (85 Firemaking required for this optional step)
4 regular planks and 8 nails of any kind to repair one side of the bridge to Mos Le'Harmless via K'Chunk's island

kills.t: General Gromblod, General Shredflesh, and General Bre'egth (level 85)
A number of Ork warriors (level 79, can be avoided entirely by attacking General Gromblod immediately)

rewards.t: Free access to the Zanaris Market
Ability to use the fairy rings and get into Zanaris without a dramen or lunar staff.
Ability to fetch teeth to get a Tooth creature by speaking to the Tooth Fairy after the quest.
Ability to have gardeners keep your farming patches weed free. First, talk to Martin the Master Gardener after the quest, then talk to a gardener at one of the patches.
If any patch has preexisting weeds, you'll have to remove them before this takes effect.
Access to a new battle area in Ork's Rift, which contains cursed Ivory Bre'egth, cursed Ivory Gromblod, and cursed Ivory Shredflesh.
Ability to sell suqah teeth to the Tooth Fairy for 2000 coins each. You can also sell her old teeth, monkey dentures, and kebbit teeth, for amounts ranging from 1 coins to 200 coins.
Access to Mos Le'Harmless through K'Chunk's island; accessible from fairy ring code DIP.
Requires 8 planks and 16 of any type of nail to repair the bridge which must be repaired from both sides.

steps.t: Use any fairy ring to travel to Zanaris. If you can start the quest, you will be redirected to the Sparse Plane.

sub.t: If you cannot start the quest, enter and leave Zanaris via fairy rings repeatedly until Fairy Very Wise appears and talks to you. It may require up to 30 minutes after completing A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen. If you've declined her before, you have to travel by fairy ring BIR to reach her.

p: A player turning on the projector.

steps.t: Talk to Fairy Very Wise and accept her offer [Chat: 4 Of course I'll help. What do I need to do?]. After accepting her offer, Nuff's certificate is no longer needed to reach the Fairy Resistance headquarters.
p: The Sparse Plane where you meet Fairy Very Wise again.

steps.t: Accept the teleport from her [Chat: 1 Please teleport me there right away!], or use the fairy ring to get to the Fairy Resistance headquarters (AIR, DLR, DJQ, AJS).
Talk to the Fairy Queen south-east in the headquarters and then finish talking to the Tooth Fairy (she automatically speaks to you after you speak with the queen). [Chat: 2 Yes, I'll help. › Accept]
Be wary of cutscenes that may trigger epilepsy. Talk to the Tooth Fairy, then turn on the projector to watch the first briefing. [Chat: 2 Show a non-flickering briefing.]
Talk to the Tooth Fairy again after the briefing. [Chat: 5 Right, I understand about fairy tooth magic now. › 1 Yes, I'm ready.]
Turn on the projector to watch the second briefing.
End of cutscenes.
After both briefings, agree to collect her wand. [Chat: 3 Yes, I'll go and collect your wand.]
Run north-west and take a hammer and secateurs from on top of the crates. You may use area loot. Use them on each other to create a tooth extractor.
Leave through the fairy ring.
Go to the house north-west of Zanaris bank. Use your tooth extractor on the door to pick the lock on it.
Talk to Gnarly. [Chat: 4 Can I do something for you...in return for the wand?]
In no particular order, compliment him with the following responses (Only 3 compliments may be needed to continue to the next part):

sub.t: "Your enamel shimmers like a river of silver in the moonlight."
"I've never seen such amazing, inspired and dream-like toothiness."
"I can see your bicuspid ancestry is an example to all molar-kind."
"You're a wonderful guard tooth with lovely cusps."

steps.t: Use the bucket of milk on him [Chat: 2 Okay, I'll close my eyes. › 2 Okay, okay! Keep your enamel on, I'll pick you up.]. Gnarly should jump into your inventory.
Use the fairy rings to go back to the Fairy Resistance HQ.
Talk to the Tooth Fairy in the south-east room, then turn on the projector.
After the briefing, agree to the tooth extraction. [Chat: 2 Yes, I understand all of that. › 2 Yes, I accept. › 3 Pain? Bring it on! Replace my tooth. › 4 Okay, thanks.]
Step onto the yellow flowers and use the wave emote. There will be a cutscene.
Leave through the fairy ring.
Talk to General Bre'egth outside of the Zanaris mill, northwest of the fairy ring. [Chat: 3 What's wrong with your mouth?]
Talk to any other Ork about K'Chunk. [Chat: 4 Do you know anything about K'Chunk?]
Run to the fairy ring, talk to Fairy Fixit about K'Chunk. [Chat: 2 What do you know about K'Chunk?]
Teleport to DIP and talk to K'Chunk. [Chat: 4 You knocked out Bre'egth's tooth, didn't you?]

sub.t: Recommended: Bring 4 regular planks and 8 nails of any kind to fix the bridge by using a plank on the broken bridge.
Recommended: Bring 8 willow logs if you have level 85 Firemaking, light the campfire for K'Chunk and receive 10,000 Firemaking experience.

steps.t: Pickpocket him for the tooth.
Teleport to BKQ.
Head down the waterfall to talk to the Wood Dryad to the west. [Chat: 2 Have you seen Gromblod?]
Talk to General Gromblod.
Talk to the Wood Dryad again.
p: The mango with General Gromblod's tooth

steps.t: Teleport to CLR.
Pick a mango from the mango tree.

sub.t: Optional: unblock this end of the hollow log if you haven't yet.

p: Place: Mango tree (A Fairy Tale III)

steps.t: Return to BKQ.
Talk to Gromblod, giving him the mango, he will spit it out about 15 tiles south of where he is standing. It does not appear as a red dot on the minimap.
Pick up the mango with tooth and use the tooth extractor on it.

Teleport to ALP and talk to General Shredflesh. [Chat: 4 Can I help with something? › 1 So your tooth is really hurting, is it? › 2 Which tooth is it that's so terribly painful and hurting? › 3 And the pain is very high is it? › 4 I'm a dentist; I can extract it for you!]
In no particular order, calm him with the following responses:

sub.t: "What's a bit of pain for a huge ork hero like you?"
"If the tooth isn't pulled out, all your teeth will hurt much worse!"
"Let me pull it out! What are you, an ork or a goblin?"
"I'll make sure it doesn't hurt a bit; I'm a professional."

steps.t: Use the extractor on him.
Clear the pile of rock behind him if you haven't yet already.
Go back and talk to the Tooth Fairy in the hideout.
Turn-on the projector to watch another briefing. [Chat: 5 Okay, thanks.]
She gives you the fairy wand.
Prepare for the final battle, with the above listed items.
Teleport to BIR, DIP, CLR, ALP. (If the fairy ring at BIR does not appear, lobby and start over.)
Look-through the fairy tree where you'll encounter a cutscene.
After the cutscene talk to the Tooth Fairy.
How to kill the Fairy Godfather:

sub.t: Use all 3 teeth on the farming patches.
Stand by the patches and kill the generals and ork warriors; Prioritise any general using the drum near the rift, to stop new orks from spawning.
Once the teeth have grown, instruct them to fight.
Focus on ork warriors while the teeth focus on killing the generals.
After you and the teeth kill the generals, kill the godfather.
You must let the teeth attack the godfather to reduce the shields. Ensure all 3 teeth are attacking the godfather at once, as each one removes a layer of his 3-layer shield.
If all 3 teeth are not attacking the godfather, you will not land hits as his shield will still be active. The melee tooth will not path around the player if you are in the way.

p: The Ivory orks attack the Godfather.
The Godfather getting sucked into the rift

steps.t: Talk to the Fairy Godfather for a cutscene.
Continue dialogue with the Fairy Queen and accept her teleport. [Chat: 1 Yes, please teleport me there now.]
Talk to Martin the Master Gardener. [Chat: 2 Talk about farming problems and fairies.]
Quest complete!

The certificate is not needed after starting A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.
